# Likelihood-Ratio Test (LRT) Oracle Fixture

This fixture stores a saved DESeq2 R likelihood-ratio-test oracle for a smooth
synthetic 2x2 (batch x condition) dataset. The dataset has no Cook-outlier /
zero-cell / extreme-LFC stress injection, so DESeq2's default parametric
dispersion trend fits cleanly and matches FlashDEG's parametric path. This
isolates the LRT statistic / p-value / df logic from dispersion-trend method
differences (already covered by the Wald interaction oracle and unit tests).

CTest does not run R for this oracle. It runs FlashDEG with `--test LRT` against
the committed counts/metadata for two nested reduced models and compares each
result to the saved DESeq2 reference with `tools/oracle_lrt_diff.py`
(relative-or-absolute tolerances, an NA-mask bound, and an exact DEG-set check).

Files (generated by `tools/oracle_lrt.R`):

- `oracle_lrt_counts.csv`, `oracle_lrt_metadata.csv` — the dataset.
- `oracle_lrt_condition_deseq2.csv` — full `~ condition` vs reduced `~ 1` (df = 1).
- `oracle_lrt_batch_condition_deseq2.csv` — full `~ batch + condition` vs reduced
  `~ batch` (df = 1).

Both cases display the `condition` B-vs-A contrast (`--contrast condition B A`),
matching the DESeq2 `results(contrast = c("condition", "B", "A"))` LFC column.

Regenerate only when intentionally updating the oracle snapshot (requires R +
DESeq2), from the repository root:

```bash
Rscript tools/oracle_lrt.R
cp tools/results/oracle_lrt_counts.csv tools/results/oracle_lrt_metadata.csv \
   tools/results/oracle_lrt_condition_deseq2.csv \
   tools/results/oracle_lrt_batch_condition_deseq2.csv \
   tests/fixtures/oracle_lrt/
# then refresh PROVENANCE.md (SHA-256)
```

The `oracle_lrt` CTest target activates automatically once
`oracle_lrt_condition_deseq2.csv` exists here (see `CMakeLists.txt`).
